findings.what: Reminder sweep has no lower bound on lateness; if the cron stalls, reminders are sent late (outside 24h±5min) rather than skipped; window relies entirely on cron cadence.
A reschedule after the sweep claims a reminder can still produce a reminder email for the new time; lease mismatch then leaves reminder_sent false so a second reminder follows.
reassignAppointment does not reject appointments in the past.
Rate limiting is in-memory per instance, and the public slot lookup (fetchSlots) is not rate-limited.
Staff schedule uses a custom grid instead of the Schedule-X resource view named in PRD §8.1.
DB unique index covers only identical start times; overlaps between multi-slot visits rely solely on the app-level advisory lock, not an exclusion constraint.
